mcqs.question: In how many of the 13 categories did Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Yagantipalle, secure first place while receiving the Best Zonal KVK Award 2024–25?
mcqs.explanation: Krishi Vigyan Kendra, Yagantipalle, secured first place in 10 of the 13 categories. The other options are incorrect because the reported performance was 10 categories, not 8, 9 or 12.
